prompts.base: A woman in a red dress walks slowly through a bright living room.
prompts.edit: A woman in a blue dress walks slowly through a bright living room.

prompts.base: A red car drives down a sunny city street.
prompts.edit: A black car drives down a sunny city street.

prompts.base: A cat walks across a bright living room floor in daylight.
prompts.edit: A cat walks across a dim living room floor at night.

prompts.base: A person sits at a wooden table in warm sunlight.
prompts.edit: A person sits at a wooden table in cool blue light.

prompts.base: A cyclist in a green jacket rides along a coastal road.
prompts.edit: A cyclist in a yellow jacket rides along a coastal road.

prompts.base: A dog runs through a green park on a sunny day.
prompts.edit: A dog runs through a green park in light rain.

prompts.base: A man looks at the camera with a neutral expression.
prompts.edit: A man looks at the camera and smiles briefly.

prompts.base: A slow shot of a vase of flowers on a table.
prompts.edit: A slow close-up shot of a vase of flowers on a table.

gate_b_editability.calibration_note: Chunk 0 has no visual history; text rebind there equals the full-regeneration chunk bit-for-bit and calibrates R_k.
gate_b_editability.note: Only `evidence: directional` prompts enter this aggregate; qualitative prompts only report a proxy-consistent change count.

cases.base_prompt: A person sits at a wooden table in warm sunlight.
cases.edit_prompt: A person sits at a wooden table in cool blue light.
cases.recache_note: recache rebuilds the cache from unchanged latents under the new prompt; the self-attention K/V are prompt-independent, so this should reproduce the checkpoint cache exactly.

preservation.note: Gate C is asserted on pre-decode latents; the VAE is causal, so any post-decode leak is reported here separately.
